body_markdown:
# Introduction

This vocabulary test checks common words used in everyday English. Choose the best answer and review the key after completing all questions.

## Section A: Choose the meaning

**1. “Punctual” means:**

A. On time B. Very late C. Unhappy

**2. “Purchase” means:**

A. Sell B. Buy C. Borrow

**3. “Assist” means:**

A. Help B. Refuse C. Forget

**4. “Quiet” means:**

A. Noisy B. Calm or making little noise C. Angry

**5. “Repair” means:**

A. Break B. Fix C. Hide

## Section B: Choose the opposite

**6. Opposite of “early”:**

A. Late B. Soon C. First

**7. Opposite of “strong”:**

A. Powerful B. Weak C. Hard

**8. Opposite of “accept”:**

A. Receive B. Agree C. Refuse

**9. Opposite of “clean”:**

A. Dirty B. Fresh C. Clear

**10. Opposite of “increase”:**

A. Grow B. Decrease C. Add

## Section C: Choose the synonym

**11. “Begin” means nearly the same as:**

A. Start B. Finish C. Stop

**12. “Quick” means nearly the same as:**

A. Slow B. Fast C. Weak

**13. “Angry” means nearly the same as:**

A. Calm B. Furious C. Happy

## Section D: Complete the sentences

14. Please ___ the door. (close / sleep)  
15. I ___ breakfast every morning. (have / drive)  
16. The doctor works in a ___. (hospital / station)  
17. A person who teaches students is a ___. (teacher / driver)

## Answer key

1. A — On time  
2. B — Buy  
3. A — Help  
4. B — Calm or making little noise  
5. B — Fix  
6. A — Late  
7. B — Weak  
8. C — Refuse  
9. A — Dirty  
10. B — Decrease  
11. A — Start  
12. B — Fast  
13. B — Furious  
14. close  
15. have  
16. hospital  
17. teacher

## Score guide

- 15–17: Very good everyday vocabulary.
- 11–14: Good progress; revise the words you missed.
- 0–10: Practise 5–10 common words daily and use each in a sentence.

## Make the words yours

Choose five new words from this test. Write one original sentence for each and say the sentences aloud.

faq.question: How can I improve my vocabulary?
faq.answer: Learn a few useful words daily, understand their meanings and use them in your own sentences.

faq.question: Should I learn only word meanings?
faq.answer: Also learn pronunciation, common word combinations and example sentences.

faq.question: How often should I take a vocabulary test?
faq.answer: Try a short test weekly and review mistakes between tests.
